answer: A concrete sybil defense: each identity climbs a violet trust curve rises only through independent peer attestations. When coordinated clones drive a graph cluster to its nadir via mutual-attestation detection, the entire segment is quarantined. Unlike the fables sybil operators tell about organic growth, every attestation anchors to a real epoch challenge response—no precomputed stories count. Verification requires fresh signatures on live challenges, so an attacker must keep N live participants across rounds, making cost scale with fleet size while marginal reward per clone stays capped.
